/* Identidade visual oficial Um Quarto */
.brand{letter-spacing:normal;gap:0}.brand-logo{display:block;height:auto;width:185px;max-width:100%;object-fit:contain;aspect-ratio:662/126}.landing-top .brand-logo{width:205px}.sidebar .brand{padding-left:9px;max-width:194px}.sidebar .brand-logo{width:180px}.auth-box .brand-logo{width:190px}.brand-icon-small{width:28px;height:33px;object-fit:contain;border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:0}.mini-head-avatar.brand-icon-small{display:block;width:30px;height:36px;object-fit:contain;background:none;border:0;border-radius:0}
/* Biblioteca de materiais */
.material-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(270px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:18px}.material-item{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--stroke);border-radius:20px;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;min-width:0;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.material-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px}.material-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:45px;height:45px;font-size:21px;background:#eaf8f3;border-radius:14px}.material-item h3{font-size:17px;margin:4px 0 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.material-item p{font-size:13px;color:#61716d;line-height:1.6;margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.material-item .material-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:auto;padding-top:12px}.material-controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 190px;gap:9px;max-width:680px}.material-help{border:1px solid #dfebe5;border-radius:17px;background:#f0f9f5;padding:15px 18px;color:#547267;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}.legacy-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-top:14px;color:#586e68;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid #e1e7e1;border-radius:11px;padding:10px 12px;background:#fff}.legacy-link:hover{border-color:#19b69d;color:#14836e}.landing-top .legacy-link{margin:0 10px 0 auto}.legacy-link.sidebar-legacy{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin:10px 0 12px}.legacy-mobile{position:fixed;bottom:78px;right:12px;z-index:38;font-size:11px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:none}.file-status{font-size:12px;color:#5b7e72;min-height:16px;margin-top:8px}.material-badge{font-size:11px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;color:#42816a;background:#edf8f2;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 9px;font-weight:800}
@media(max-width:820px){.legacy-mobile{display:inline-flex}.sidebar-legacy{display:none}.landing-top .legacy-link{font-size:10px;padding:8px;margin-left:auto}.landing-top .brand-logo{width:150px}.material-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}}@media(max-width:540px){.material-controls{grid-template-columns:1fr}.landing-top .legacy-link{font-size:10px}.landing-top .brand-logo{width:135px}}
/* Filtros do diário: compactos, combináveis e responsivos */
.lesson-filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;align-items:end;margin:10px 0 14px}
.lesson-filters .field{margin:0;min-width:0}
.lesson-filters label{margin-bottom:6px}
.lesson-filters input,.lesson-filters select{width:100%;min-width:0;background:#fbfdfb}
.lesson-filters-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--stroke);padding:0 0 15px;margin:0 0 15px}
.lesson-filter-summary{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.lesson-filters.single{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));max-width:650px}
.lesson-filter-reset{white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:1040px){.lesson-filters{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:520px){.lesson-filters,.lesson-filters.single{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lesson-filters-footer{align-items:flex-start}}
/* v4: quadro Kanban, lembretes, escola e avatar */
.profile-avatar.avatar-action{border:0;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;padding:0;flex:0 0 40px}
.profile-avatar.avatar-action img,.top-avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:inherit;display:block}
.profile-trigger{border:0;background:transparent;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer}
.profile-trigger:focus-visible,.avatar-action:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--green);outline-offset:4px}
.top-avatar{display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:#dcefe9;color:#237b6f;font-weight:800;overflow:hidden}
.field-note{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;margin-top:6px}
input[readonly]{background:#f2f7f3;color:#59716b}
.rating-grid-new{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.lesson-observations{white-space:pre-wrap;background:#f2f9f5;color:#477468;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin:9px 0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}
.task-toolbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(170px,1fr) 170px auto;gap:11px;margin:14px 0 18px;align-items:center}
.task-toolbar .btn{white-space:nowrap}
.task-overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:14px 0}
.task-info{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--stroke);border-radius:17px;padding:17px;min-width:0;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.task-info b{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-size:27px;display:block;margin:5px 0}
.task-info small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.reminder-bar{border:1px solid #f1ddbb;background:#fffaf0;color:#806535;border-radius:18px;padding:16px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.reminder-bar strong{font-size:14px}
.reminder-bar p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin:5px 0 0}
.kanban-board-new{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:15px;align-items:start}
.kanban-column-new{min-width:0;background:#eef3ee;border:1px solid #e4ebe4;border-radius:21px;padding:13px;min-height:240px;transition:box-shadow .15s}
.kanban-column-new.over{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--green)}
.kanban-column-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 5px 13px;font-size:14px}
.kanban-column-head .pill{background:#fff}
.study-task-card{border:1px solid #e2e9e1;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;box-shadow:0 5px 16px #173f2510;cursor:grab;min-width:0}
.study-task-card:active{cursor:grabbing}
.study-task-card .task-matter{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#569484;font-weight:800}
.study-task-card h3{font-size:14px;line-height:1.38;margin:8px 0;font-weight:800;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.study-task-card p{font-size:12px;color:#6c7a74;margin:4px 0 10px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;white-space:pre-wrap}
.task-topline,.task-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.task-chip{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;background:#f2f5f0;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px;color:#668076;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.task-chip.overdue{background:#fde8e4;color:#ad5041}
.task-chip.soon{background:#fff0d6;color:#916b29}
.task-priority{font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.task-priority.alta{color:#bd6254}.task-priority.media{color:#b58b40}.task-priority.baixa{color:#679c8a}
.task-actions{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:11px}
.task-actions button{font-size:11px;border:1px solid var(--stroke);background:#fafcf9;color:var(--ink);border-radius:9px;padding:6px 9px}
.task-actions button:hover{background:#e8f6ed}
.task-empty{color:#9baa9e;font-size:12px;text-align:center;padding:22px 7px}
.task-help{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0;line-height:1.5}
.avatar-presets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:10px;margin:18px 0}
.avatar-choice{border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:17px;background:#eef8f3;aspect-ratio:1;font-size:26px;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer}
.avatar-choice.selected{border-color:var(--green);background:#dff5ed}
.avatar-preview{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;background:#f6f9f4;border-radius:15px}
.avatar-preview .top-avatar{width:55px;height:55px;font-size:25px}
@media(max-width:1040px){.kanban-board-new{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.task-toolbar{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.task-toolbar .btn{grid-column:1/-1}}
@media(max-width:720px){.kanban-board-new{grid-template-columns:1fr}.task-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.task-info{padding:12px}.task-info b{font-size:22px}.task-info small{font-size:10px}.rating-grid-new{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.mobile-bar{overflow-x:auto;justify-content:flex-start;scrollbar-width:thin}.mobile-bar .nav-link{flex:1 0 65px}.task-toolbar{grid-template-columns:1fr}.task-toolbar .btn{grid-column:auto}.avatar-presets{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
/* =========== GUIA IFES: clean, responsiva e privada por acesso =========== */
.ifes-hero{background:linear-gradient(115deg,#263f3d,#215e57);color:#fff;padding:29px;border-radius:25px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin-bottom:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ifes-hero::after{content:'✳';position:absolute;right:26px;top:-55px;font-size:180px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.055);pointer-events:none}
.ifes-hero h1{font-size:clamp(27px,3vw,38px);margin:3px 0 9px;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.ifes-hero p{color:#d5e9e0;max-width:570px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;margin:0}
.ifes-hero .eyebrow{color:#a6edcd}
.ifes-hero-score{min-width:152px;padding:17px 23px;background:#ffffff18;border:1px solid #ffffff30;border-radius:19px;text-align:center;z-index:1}
.ifes-hero-score b{display:block;font-size:37px;line-height:1.1}
.ifes-hero-score span{font-size:11px;opacity:.9}
.ifes-overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:14px 0 20px}
.ifes-overview button{min-width:0;text-align:left;background:#fff;color:#293f3a;border:1px solid #e4ebe5;border-radius:19px;padding:17px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s,border-color .15s;box-shadow:0 5px 20px #1b3d2308}
.ifes-overview button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#68c6aa}
.ifes-overview button.active{border-color:#1bb398;background:#edf9f5;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #1bb398}
.ifes-overview .ifes-emoji{font-size:23px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px}
.ifes-overview strong{font-size:13px;display:block;line-height:1.35;min-height:34px}
.ifes-overview small{display:block;color:#7a8c83;font-size:11px;margin:8px 0}
.ifes-track{height:8px;width:100%;background:#eaf0eb;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin:8px 0}
.ifes-track span{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:10px;background:#1db69e;transition:width .2s}
.ifes-subprogress{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;color:#6f8077;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.ifes-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4ebe5;border-radius:22px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:15px}
.ifes-panel-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:13px;margin-bottom:13px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ifes-panel h2,.ifes-manager h2{margin:0;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.ifes-sub{color:#74857c;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:5px}
.ifes-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ifes-toolbar input{border:1px solid #dce8df;background:#f9fbf9;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;min-width:170px;max-width:290px;font-size:13px}
.ifes-unit{border:1px solid #e5ede6;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:10px;background:#fff}
.ifes-unit-btn{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:none;background:#fff;color:#273e37;width:100%;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;padding:15px;font-family:inherit}
.ifes-unit-btn:hover{background:#f7faf7}
.ifes-unit-btn .ifes-roman{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:29px;height:29px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:9px;background:#edf7f3;color:#189478;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}
.ifes-unit-name{font-weight:850;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4}
.ifes-unit-minor{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#78897f;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}
.ifes-unit-content{padding:3px 13px 11px;background:#fcfefd;border-top:1px solid #edf2ee}
.ifes-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px;padding:11px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef2ee;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:#40544a}
.ifes-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.ifes-item-button{flex-shrink:0;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;height:21px;width:21px;border:1.7px solid #c6d9cd;border-radius:7px;background:white;color:white;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer;margin-top:0px}
.ifes-item-button.done{background:#1bb398;border-color:#1bb398}
.ifes-item-button:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.58}
.ifes-item.done .ifes-item-text{color:#8a9990;text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.ifes-item-text{flex:1;min-width:0}
.ifes-status{white-space:nowrap;color:#189f87;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;margin-left:auto}
.ifes-manager{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfe9e0;border-radius:20px;padding:18px;margin:0 0 16px}
.ifes-manager-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:11px 4px;border-top:1px solid #edf2ee}
.ifes-manager-row:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.ifes-user-name{font-weight:800;font-size:13px;display:block;line-height:1.3}
.ifes-user-email{font-size:11px;color:#81928a;display:block;margin-top:4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.ifes-tag{display:inline-flex;background:#e5f8f0;color:#168a6e;border-radius:50px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:850}
.ifes-tag.off{background:#f3f5f3;color:#809086}
.ifes-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.ifes-actions .btn{white-space:nowrap}
.ifes-readonly{background:#fff9ed;border:1px solid #f6e8c9;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 15px;color:#846a3d;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:15px}
.ifes-no-data{padding:36px;text-align:center;color:#7b8c80;font-size:13px}
.ifes-references{border-top:1px solid #e5ede6;margin-top:18px;padding:15px 5px 2px;color:#6b8071;font-size:12px}.ifes-references summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;color:#356b59}.ifes-references p{white-space:pre-line;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;margin-top:12px;color:#708177}
.ifes-topline{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.ifes-topline .btn{font-size:12px}
.ifes-search-only{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:#73857a;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
.ifes-search-only input{min-width:auto;width:16px;height:16px}
@media(max-width:1120px){.ifes-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:730px){.ifes-hero{padding:20px;grid-template-columns:1fr}.ifes-hero-score{width:100%;text-align:left}.ifes-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.ifes-panel{padding:13px}.ifes-unit-minor{white-space:normal}.ifes-toolbar input{max-width:100%;width:100%}.ifes-toolbar{width:100%}.ifes-manager-row{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.ifes-actions{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start}}
@media(max-width:410px){.ifes-overview{gap:8px}.ifes-overview button{padding:12px}.ifes-hero h1{font-size:26px}.ifes-unit-name{font-size:12px}}
/* V6: modos, conteúdos detalhados e financeiro privado */
.role-switch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:4px;background:#edf3ee;border:1px solid #e3ebe4;border-radius:13px;flex:0 0 auto}
.role-switch button{background:transparent;color:#708278;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap}
.role-switch button.active{background:white;color:#137e6a;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #1a553411}
.role-label{font-size:11px;color:#657f70;font-weight:800;background:#e5f2e9;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px}
.preview-flag{padding:13px 17px;background:#fff4cf;border:1px solid #f5db99;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:19px;color:#7a5d20;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.6}
.demo-role-buttons{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:13px}
.demo-role-buttons .btn{font-size:12px}
.ifes-open-lesson{border:1px solid #dbe8de;background:#f6fbf8;color:#197a63;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
.ifes-open-lesson:hover{background:#e3f6e9}
.ifes-detail-wrap{max-width:980px;margin:auto}.ifes-detail-cover{background:linear-gradient(118deg,#244742,#168e78);border-radius:25px;padding:31px 33px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:17px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.ifes-detail-cover:after{content:'✳';position:absolute;right:-4px;top:-60px;font-size:210px;color:#ffffff13;pointer-events:none}.ifes-detail-cover .eyebrow{color:#a9ebd8}.ifes-detail-cover h1{font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,37px);letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:10px 0 8px;max-width:620px}.ifes-detail-cover p{color:#d7eee6;line-height:1.6;font-size:13px;max-width:600px}.ifes-detail-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}.ifes-detail-tag{display:inline-flex;background:#e5f7ee;color:#177a61;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}.ifes-study-card{background:white;border:1px solid #e5ebe4;padding:24px;border-radius:22px;margin-bottom:16px}.ifes-study-card h2{font-size:21px;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 12px}.ifes-study-card p,.ifes-study-card li{font-size:14px;color:#52665a;line-height:1.75}.ifes-study-card ol,.ifes-study-card ul{padding-left:22px}.ifes-study-card strong{color:#243e32}.ifes-solve{display:grid;gap:9px;background:#f2f9f4;padding:18px;border-radius:15px;border:1px solid #dfeee3;font-size:16px;color:#2c4e3c;font-weight:700}.ifes-example-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}.ifes-study-card details{background:#f6faf6;border:1px solid #e4eee5;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}.ifes-study-card summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;color:#2b6651}.ifes-placeholder{border-left:4px solid #ddb76b;background:#fffaf0;padding:16px;border-radius:10px}
.money-fields{background:#f5f9f5;border:1px solid #dcebe0;padding:17px;border-radius:15px;margin:16px 0}.money-fields h3{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 8px}.money-fields .field{margin-bottom:8px}.money-preview{margin-top:7px;padding:12px;border-radius:11px;background:#e4f4eb;color:#24634a;font-size:14px;font-weight:800}.money-tip{font-size:11px;color:#657e6b;line-height:1.5}
.finance-hero{padding:25px 28px;background:#243f3e;color:white;border-radius:24px;margin-bottom:16px}.finance-hero h1{font-size:31px;margin:8px 0}.finance-hero p{color:#bed5cd;font-size:13px;margin:5px 0}.finance-filter{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;align-items:end}.finance-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:16px 0}.finance-metric{background:white;border:1px solid var(--stroke);border-radius:18px;padding:18px}.finance-metric small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#7b9084;font-weight:800}.finance-metric strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,25px);margin-top:8px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.finance-metric em{font-size:11px;color:#839589;font-style:normal}.finance-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto}.finance-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px}.finance-table th{background:#f6faf7;font-size:11px;color:#748a7a;text-align:left}.finance-table td,.finance-table th{padding:12px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e7ede7}.finance-table tfoot td{font-weight:800;background:#eef7f1}.finance-chart{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:9px;height:140px;overflow:auto;padding:10px 0}.finance-month{min-width:55px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:100%;justify-content:flex-end}.finance-month-bar{width:min(45px,100%);background:linear-gradient(0deg,#18ab8c,#a1e2bf);border-radius:9px 9px 2px 2px;min-height:2px}.finance-month-label{font-size:10px;color:#798e80;font-weight:800}.finance-month-value{font-size:9px;color:#456d57;white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:940px){.finance-filter,.finance-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:620px){.ifes-example-grid,.finance-filter,.finance-metrics{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ifes-detail-cover{padding:23px}.ifes-study-card{padding:17px}.role-switch button{padding:8px 7px;font-size:10px}.app-top{gap:7px}.app-top .top-right{gap:6px}.role-label{font-size:10px;padding:7px}.ifes-item{flex-wrap:wrap}.ifes-open-lesson{margin-left:32px}}
/* V9 · Valores financeiros discretos no histórico; visíveis apenas para a administração. */
.lesson-row{align-items:flex-start}
.lesson-side{width:306px;flex:0 0 306px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px}
.lesson-finance-summary{width:100%;background:#fafcf9;border:1px solid #e9eee9;border-radius:14px;padding:13px 14px}
.lesson-finance-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.lesson-finance-col{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.lesson-finance-col+ .lesson-finance-col{padding-left:12px;border-left:1px solid #e8eee8}
.lesson-finance-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.01em;color:#8d9c92;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.lesson-finance-value{font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;color:#4b5f55;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.lesson-finance-col.is-net .lesson-finance-value{color:#287c5c}
.lesson-finance-pending{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;color:#8d9c92;min-height:30px}
.lesson-finance-pending .mini-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#b8c7bc;flex:0 0 6px}
.lesson-finance-summary[aria-label]{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
@media(max-width:1210px){.lesson-side{width:275px;flex-basis:275px}.lesson-finance-summary{padding:12px}.lesson-finance-grid{gap:7px}.lesson-finance-col+.lesson-finance-col{padding-left:8px}.lesson-finance-value{font-size:12px}}
@media(max-width:760px){.lesson-row{flex-wrap:wrap}.lesson-detail{flex-basis:calc(100% - 64px)}.lesson-side{width:100%;flex:1 0 100%;padding-left:62px;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end}.lesson-finance-summary{width:auto;flex:1 1 240px}.lesson-side>.btn{flex:0 0 auto}}
@media(max-width:440px){.lesson-side{padding-left:0;display:flex;align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column}.lesson-side>.btn{align-self:flex-end}.lesson-finance-grid{gap:12px}.lesson-finance-value{font-size:13px}}
/* V10 · valores financeiros editáveis diretamente no histórico */
.lesson-finance-edit-trigger{display:block;border:0;background:transparent;text-align:left;padding:1px 0;margin:0;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.4;border-radius:3px;font:inherit;font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;color:#4b5f55;white-space:nowrap}
.lesson-finance-edit-trigger:hover{color:#218258;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.lesson-finance-edit-trigger:focus-visible,.lesson-finance-new:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2e9974;outline-offset:3px}
.lesson-finance-new{border:0;background:transparent;color:#397d60;font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;padding:0;line-height:1.4}
.lesson-finance-new:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.lesson-finance-editing{background:#fff;border-color:#b4d7c3;box-shadow:0 5px 17px rgba(30,85,50,.06)}
.lesson-finance-edit-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#345a47;margin-bottom:10px}
.lesson-finance-edit-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.lesson-finance-edit-fields label{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#87948b;display:block;min-width:0}
.lesson-finance-edit-fields input{width:100%;min-width:0;margin-top:5px;padding:8px 7px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce7df;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;color:#254936;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3}
.lesson-finance-edit-fields input:focus{outline:2px solid #b7ddc5;outline-offset:0;border-color:#79b696}
.lesson-finance-net-preview{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-top:11px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid #edf1ec;color:#8d9c92;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.lesson-finance-net-preview strong{color:#287c5c;font-size:12px}
.lesson-finance-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:12px}
.lesson-finance-actions .btn{padding:7px 10px;font-size:10px}
.lesson-finance-shortcut{margin-top:8px;font-size:9px;color:#a1aaa5;text-align:right}
@media(max-width:1210px){.lesson-finance-edit-trigger{font-size:12px}}
/* ENEM: respeita visual da guia IFES e mantém conteúdo acessível em telas pequenas */
.enem-hero{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#173c37 0%,#227866 80%,#2ca78d 100%)}
.enem-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.enem-tabs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:#f1f6f1;border:1px solid #e5ede6;border-radius:14px;padding:5px;max-width:550px;margin:10px 0 14px}
.enem-tabs button{flex:1;border:0;border-radius:11px;background:transparent;color:#60766b;font-weight:850;font-size:12px;padding:12px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.enem-tabs button.active{background:#fff;color:#168f74;box-shadow:0 2px 9px #143d2215}
.enem-eixos{margin-top:18px;border:1px solid #dcece2;background:#f8fcf9;border-radius:14px;padding:16px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#466455}
.enem-eixos summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:850;color:#217e68}
.enem-eixos li{margin:10px 0}
.material-upload-diagnostic{border:1px solid #f0cbaf;background:#fff9f4;color:#764527;border-radius:12px;padding:13px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:10px;white-space:normal}
.material-upload-diagnostic strong{display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.material-upload-diagnostic code{font-size:11px;background:#fff2e8;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:5px}
.material-upload-progressbar{width:100%;height:9px;accent-color:#1bb398;margin-top:7px}
@media(max-width:870px){.enem-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:470px){.enem-tabs{flex-direction:column}.enem-tabs button{width:100%}.enem-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
/* V16 · Filtros de varios alunos e relatorios mensais */
.uq-header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.uq-multi-picker{position:relative;width:100%;min-width:0;z-index:4}
.uq-multi-picker[open]{z-index:30}
.uq-multi-picker>summary{list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:41px;padding:10px 13px;border:1px solid #dfe7e1;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:#17313a;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px}
.uq-multi-picker>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.uq-multi-picker>summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #21b7a1;outline-offset:2px}
.uq-multi-label{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;display:block}
.uq-multi-chevron{color:#71887e;flex-shrink:0;font-size:16px}
.uq-multi-panel{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(100% + 5px);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(20,42,40,.16);border:1px solid #e3ece7;border-radius:14px;padding:9px;min-width:230px;z-index:50}
.uq-multi-all{display:block;text-align:left;background:#eaf6f1;color:#0b7568;font-weight:750;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 11px;width:100%;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.uq-multi-scroll{max-height:220px;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px 0}
.uq-multi-choice{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:9px;color:#273c44;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:550}
.uq-multi-choice:hover{background:#f5f9f6}
.uq-multi-choice input{width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:#16ad99;flex-shrink:0}
.uq-multi-note{padding:8px 5px 3px;border-top:1px solid #eef1ed;color:#76887f;font-size:10px}
.uq-empty-choices{padding:8px;font-size:12px;color:#819288}
.uq-month-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:15px}
.uq-report-sub{font-size:12px;color:#678077;line-height:1.6}

@media(max-width:760px){.uq-header-actions{width:100%;justify-content:stretch}.uq-header-actions .btn{flex:1}.uq-multi-panel{min-width:225px;right:auto;width:max(100%,260px)}}
/* V17 — público dos materiais: seleção clara, sem poluir a biblioteca. */
.material-audience{border:1px solid #dce9e3;border-radius:16px;background:#f8fbf9;padding:16px;margin:14px 0}
.material-audience h3{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 5px;color:#1e3c37}.material-audience .small{line-height:1.55}
.material-audience select,.material-audience input[type="search"]{max-width:100%}
.material-audience-panel{margin-top:13px}.material-audience-box{max-height:205px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid #dce6e0;border-radius:12px;background:white;padding:8px}

.material-audience-info{font-size:12px;color:#53756a;line-height:1.55;margin-top:8px}.material-audience-toolbar{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap}.material-sync{font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}

/* UM QUARTO V18 — Editor de tópicos, aulas e fórmulas */
.uq-topic-edit{margin-left:5px!important;background:#eaf6ef!important;color:#236c59!important;border:1px solid #d4eadd!important;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px!important}
.uq-study-editor-modal{max-width:1000px!important;width:min(1000px,97vw)!important;padding:27px!important}
.uq-edit-head{margin-bottom:20px;padding-right:36px}

.uq-editor-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px 18px}
.uq-editor-block{border:1px solid #e1eae3;padding:17px;border-radius:17px;background:#fff;min-width:0}

.uq-edit-entry .uq-line-input{margin-top:9px}
.uq-mini-action{font-size:11px!important;padding:8px 11px!important;border-radius:10px!important;background:#e8f3ea!important;color:#246d53!important;border:1px solid #d3e7da!important;font-weight:800}
.uq-remove-action{background:#fff6f3!important;color:#a25146!important;border-color:#f3e1db!important}
.uq-topic-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:sticky;bottom:-27px;background:white;padding:17px 0 8px;border-top:1px solid #edf0eb;margin-top:18px}
.uq-study-content{display:grid;gap:18px;margin:18px 0}
.uq-study-note{border-left:3px solid #20b696;background:#f1faf6;padding:12px 17px;border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;color:#365f50;font-size:13px}
.uq-study-text{white-space:pre-wrap;color:#53655a;line-height:1.8;font-size:14px}
.uq-study-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin:9px 0}
.uq-study-row .uq-num{background:#e8f5ed;border-radius:9px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;color:#287e66;font-weight:800}
.uq-formula-card{background:#f2faf7;border:1px solid #d7eee4;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;text-align:center;overflow:auto;min-height:65px}
.uq-formula-card .katex-display{margin:.8em 0}
.uq-formula-card code{font-size:14px;color:#245446;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.uq-topic-check{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin:10px 0;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:#f7faf8;font-size:12px;color:#33574b}
.uq-topic-check input{width:17px;height:17px;accent-color:#199c7d;flex:0 0 17px;margin-top:2px}
.uq-topic-check[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.65}
.uq-inline-note{font-size:11px;color:#84988b;line-height:1.5}
.uq-edit-summary{font-size:11px;color:#678577;background:#edf8f1;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 9px;white-space:nowrap}
.uq-rich-preview{border:1px solid #e0ece3;background:#f7fcf9;padding:15px;border-radius:13px;line-height:1.7;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:13px}
.uq-insert-formula-help{margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;color:#7d9388}
@media(max-width:650px){.uq-editor-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uq-editor-block.wide{grid-column:1}.uq-study-editor-modal{padding:18px!important}.uq-topic-actions{bottom:-18px}}
\n/* UM QUARTO V19 · CADASTROS E ACESSOS */
.uq-people-intro{margin:18px 0 16px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfe7e1;border-radius:20px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(29,60,50,.03)}
.uq-people-intro-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
.uq-people-intro h3{margin:3px 0 4px;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
.uq-people-intro p{color:#778780;font-size:13px;margin:0;max-width:680px}
.uq-people-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.uq-person-tile{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;border:1px solid #e3eae5;background:#fafdFA;color:#233e3b;border-radius:14px;padding:15px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;min-height:86px;transition:background .16s,border-color .16s}
.uq-person-tile:hover{background:#e9f5ef;border-color:#a4d4bd}.uq-person-tile strong{display:block;font-size:13px}.uq-person-tile small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#72837b;line-height:1.4;margin-top:5px}.uq-person-ico{width:31px;height:31px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:10px;background:#e1eee5;font-size:17px;flex:0 0 auto}
.uq-people-screen{display:grid;gap:18px;max-width:1070px}.uq-people-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.uq-people-tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.uq-people-tabs button{border:1px solid #dce6e1;background:white;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 16px;color:#567267;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}.uq-people-tabs button.active{background:#2c4946;color:white;border-color:#2c4946}
.uq-people-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(285px,385px) minmax(320px,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:start}
.uq-people-formcard,.uq-people-listcard{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e9e5;border-radius:19px;padding:24px}.uq-people-formcard h3,.uq-people-listcard h3{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 7px}.uq-people-hint{font-size:12px;color:#70847c;line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 21px}.uq-people-form{display:grid;gap:13px}.uq-people-form .uq-field{display:grid;gap:6px}.uq-people-form label{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#415953}.uq-people-form input,.uq-people-form select,.uq-people-form textarea,.uq-people-search{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;font-size:14px;border:1px solid #dbe6df;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;padding:12px 13px;color:#203d38}.uq-people-form input:focus,.uq-people-form select:focus,.uq-people-search:focus{outline:2px solid #c0e8d6;outline-offset:1px}.uq-people-form input[type=password]{letter-spacing:1px}.uq-people-form button[type=submit]{justify-content:center;min-height:46px}.uq-people-form .sub{font-size:11px;color:#82918b}
.uq-people-notice{font-size:12px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #e5eae3;background:#f5f8f3;border-radius:10px;color:#657b6e;line-height:1.55}
.uq-people-list-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:13px}.uq-people-list-head h3{margin:0}.uq-people-count{background:#eef5f0;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px;color:#557567;font-weight:800}
.uq-person-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:14px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef2ef}.uq-person-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}.uq-person-data{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-width:0}.uq-person-avatar{background:#e5f3eb;color:#35644f;width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;border-radius:12px;flex:0 0 auto}.uq-person-row strong{display:block;font-size:13px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.uq-person-row small{display:block;color:#8a9991;font-size:11px;margin-top:3px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.uq-person-row button{background:#f7f9f7;color:#466957;border:1px solid #e2ebe4;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:860px){.uq-people-actions{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uq-people-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uq-people-formcard,.uq-people-listcard{padding:18px}}
/* UM QUARTO · Plano de estudos — destinatários e ações em massa */
.uq-plan-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin:0 0 18px;padding:17px 19px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--stroke);border-radius:19px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.uq-plan-student-group{flex:1 1 285px;max-width:420px;min-width:0}
.uq-plan-student-group label{display:block;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:7px}
.uq-plan-student-group select{background:#fbfdfb;width:100%;font-weight:700}
.uq-plan-toolbar-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.uq-plan-toolbar .btn{white-space:nowrap}
.uq-plan-toolbar .uq-plan-danger{color:#ac6259;background:#fff8f7;border:1px solid #f0dfdc}
.uq-plan-toolbar .uq-plan-danger:hover{background:#ffefed}
.uq-plan-audience-hint{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#688074;background:#edf8f2;border:1px solid #dcefe5;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;margin-top:8px}
.uq-plan-destructive-warning{background:#fff6f3;border:1px solid #f0d5ce;color:#9a4f45;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 15px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;margin:16px 0}
.uq-plan-destructive-warning strong{color:#863b33}
.uq-plan-confirm-input{text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em}
.uq-plan-btn-danger{background:#a9534a!important;color:white!important}
.uq-plan-btn-danger:hover{background:#8e4139!important}
@media(max-width:820px){.uq-plan-toolbar{padding:14px}.uq-plan-student-group{max-width:none}.uq-plan-toolbar-actions{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start}.uq-plan-toolbar-actions .btn{flex:1;min-width:115px}.uq-plan-toolbar ~ .grid-two{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}}
@media(max-width:540px){.uq-plan-toolbar-actions{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}.uq-plan-toolbar-actions .btn{width:100%}.uq-plan-toolbar ~ .grid-two .card-header{flex-wrap:wrap}}
/* UM QUARTO MOBILE TASKS V11 */
.task-mobile-switch,.task-mobile-tabs,.task-mobile-hint{display:none}
.task-delete-quick{color:#b44d48!important;border-color:#f0d8d5!important}
@media(max-width:720px){
.task-mobile-switch{display:flex;gap:5px;background:#edf2ed;border-radius:13px;padding:4px;margin:0 0 12px}

.task-mobile-tabs button.active{background:#dcefe4;color:#217657}
.task-mobile-hint{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#819188;margin:0 0 12px}
.task-toolbar{grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 12px}
.task-toolbar input{min-width:0}.task-toolbar select{grid-column:1/-1}
.task-toolbar .btn{grid-column:auto;padding:10px;font-size:11px}
.task-overview{margin:9px 0}.task-info{padding:9px}.task-info b{font-size:19px;margin:2px 0}.task-info small:last-child{display:none}
.reminder-bar{padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px}.reminder-bar p:last-of-type{display:none}
.kanban-board-new{display:block;min-width:0}
.kanban-column-new{display:none;min-height:120px;padding:9px;border-radius:17px}
.kanban-column-new.mobile-active{display:block}
.study-task-card{padding:12px;border-radius:14px;cursor:default;touch-action:pan-y;position:relative}
.study-task-card h3{font-size:13px;margin:6px 0}
.study-task-card p{font-size:11px;margin:4px 0 6px;max-height:40px;overflow:hidden}
.task-bottom{gap:5px}.task-chip{font-size:10px;padding:4px 7px}
.task-actions{margin-top:9px;gap:6px}.task-actions button{min-height:36px;padding:8px 10px}
.task-actions button[data-action="task-calendar"]{display:none}

.task-mobile-list .study-task-card p{display:none}
}

#legacy-loader .legacy-card{max-width:540px;padding:32px;background:white;border:1px solid #dcebe2;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 16px 45px #213f2a11;text-align:center}

/* ENEM: respeita visual da guia IFES e mantém conteúdo acessível em telas pequenas */
.enem-hero{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#173c37 0%,#227866 80%,#2ca78d 100%)}
.enem-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.enem-tabs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:#f1f6f1;border:1px solid #e5ede6;border-radius:14px;padding:5px;max-width:550px;margin:10px 0 14px}
.enem-tabs button{flex:1;border:0;border-radius:11px;background:transparent;color:#60766b;font-weight:850;font-size:12px;padding:12px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.enem-tabs button.active{background:#fff;color:#168f74;box-shadow:0 2px 9px #143d2215}
.enem-eixos{margin-top:18px;border:1px solid #dcece2;background:#f8fcf9;border-radius:14px;padding:16px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#466455}
.enem-eixos summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:850;color:#217e68}
.enem-eixos li{margin:10px 0}
.material-upload-diagnostic{border:1px solid #f0cbaf;background:#fff9f4;color:#764527;border-radius:12px;padding:13px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:10px;white-space:normal}
.material-upload-diagnostic strong{display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.material-upload-diagnostic code{font-size:11px;background:#fff2e8;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:5px}
.material-upload-progressbar{width:100%;height:9px;accent-color:#1bb398;margin-top:7px}
@media(max-width:870px){.enem-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:470px){.enem-tabs{flex-direction:column}.enem-tabs button{width:100%}.enem-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}

.material-item .material-actions .btn{flex-shrink:0}
.material-drive-tip{margin-top:9px;border-radius:12px;background:#f1f8f4;border:1px solid #dcece2;padding:11px 13px;font-size:12px;color:#4a6a5d;line-height:1.55}

.drive-preview-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 0}

@media(max-width:600px){.drive-preview-modal{padding:14px;max-height:97dvh}.drive-preview-frame{height:65dvh;min-height:280px;border-radius:10px}.drive-preview-actions .btn{flex:1;justify-content:center}.drive-preview-heading h2{font-size:19px}}
/* UM QUARTO V20 · CALENDÁRIO ACADÊMICO · VISÃO DO PROFESSOR */
.uq-cal-page{--cal-line:#e7eee9;--cal-ink:#243a39;--cal-planned:#8a71c5;--cal-planned-soft:#f0eafd;--cal-done:#148e78;--cal-done-soft:#e0f4ed}
.uq-cal-page .section-head{margin-bottom:17px}
.uq-cal-head-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.uq-cal-topline{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cal-line);border-radius:21px;padding:17px 19px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.uq-cal-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.uq-cal-nav-arrow{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--cal-line);background:white;color:#4d6760;font-size:19px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.uq-cal-nav-arrow:hover,.uq-cal-period-today:hover{background:#edf6f1}
.uq-cal-period-today{border:1px solid var(--cal-line);border-radius:11px;background:#fff;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#39584d}
.uq-cal-period-name{font:700 18px/1.2 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;color:var(--cal-ink);min-width:225px;margin-left:7px;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.uq-cal-view-switch{display:flex;gap:3px;background:#eef3ee;border:1px solid #e6eee7;border-radius:13px;padding:4px}
.uq-cal-view-switch button{background:transparent;color:#6e7d77;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.uq-cal-view-switch button.active{color:#196f5d;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px #314a3815}
.uq-cal-filterbar{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:13px 0}
.uq-cal-filter{flex:1;min-width:125px;max-width:230px}
.uq-cal-filter label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:5px;color:#66786e}
.uq-cal-filter select,.uq-cal-filter input{background:white;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid #e0e8e2;font-size:12px;font-weight:650}
.uq-cal-clear{white-space:nowrap;margin-bottom:1px}
.uq-cal-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:14px 0}
.uq-cal-stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cal-line);border-radius:16px;padding:15px 18px;display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:center;min-width:0}
.uq-cal-stat-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#edf5ed;color:#5c8066;font-size:17px;flex:0 0 auto}
.uq-cal-stat.planned .uq-cal-stat-icon{background:var(--cal-planned-soft);color:var(--cal-planned)}
.uq-cal-stat.done .uq-cal-stat-icon{background:var(--cal-done-soft);color:var(--cal-done)}
.uq-cal-stat strong{font:700 24px/1 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;display:block;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.uq-cal-stat small{font-size:11px;color:#85948b;display:block;margin-top:5px;font-weight:650}
.uq-cal-footnote{font-size:11px;color:#83938a;line-height:1.5;margin:12px 2px 0}
.uq-cal-legend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:17px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 1px;font-size:11px;color:#64786e;font-weight:750}
.uq-cal-legend-item{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.uq-cal-legend-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--cal-planned)}
.uq-cal-legend-dot.done{background:var(--cal-done)}
.uq-cal-calendar-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cal-line);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.uq-cal-scroll{overflow-x:auto;width:100%;overscroll-behavior-x:contain}
.uq-cal-week{min-width:780px}
.uq-cal-week-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:58px repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));background:#fbfcfa;border-bottom:1px solid var(--cal-line)}
.uq-cal-week-heading{border-left:1px solid var(--cal-line);text-align:center;padding:13px 4px 11px;color:#6e8076;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.uq-cal-week-heading b{font:700 22px/1.1 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:#304d43;border-radius:11px;padding:4px 9px}
.uq-cal-week-heading.current b{background:#278d79;color:#fff}
.uq-cal-week-heading.current{color:#168b74;background:#f3faf7}
.uq-cal-week-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:58px repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));position:relative}
.uq-cal-time-axis{position:relative;background:#fafbf9;border-right:1px solid var(--cal-line)}
.uq-cal-hour{position:absolute;right:7px;transform:translateY(-8px);font:650 10px/1 'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:#94a098}
.uq-cal-hour:first-child{transform:translateY(3px)}
.uq-cal-day-column{position:relative;border-right:1px solid var(--cal-line);background:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,#fff 0px,#fff 51px,#eaf0eb 51px,#eaf0eb 52px)}
.uq-cal-day-column.current{background:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,#fbfefb 0px,#fbfefb 51px,#eaf0eb 51px,#eaf0eb 52px)}
.uq-cal-day-column:last-child{border-right:0}
.uq-cal-hour-hit{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:52px;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:0;z-index:0;cursor:crosshair}
.uq-cal-hour-hit:hover{background:#e5f3e75e}
.uq-cal-event{border:0;border-left:4px solid #6e56a9;display:block;text-align:left;border-radius:7px;background:#bda9df;color:#2f2142;padding:6px 7px 5px;min-height:23px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 2px 4px #00000010;font-family:inherit;line-height:1.25}
.uq-cal-event.planned{background:#e9e2f8;border-color:#8768b9;color:#514070}
.uq-cal-event.done{background:#c7ede7;border-color:#167f72;color:#22574d}
.uq-cal-event:hover{filter:brightness(.97);box-shadow:0 3px 8px #00000018}
.uq-cal-event.week-event{position:absolute;z-index:2;font-size:10px}
.uq-cal-event-title{font-weight:850;display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.uq-cal-event-time{font-size:9px;opacity:.85;display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-bottom:2px}
.uq-cal-event-sub{font-size:9px;opacity:.84;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;display:block;margin-top:2px}
.uq-cal-month{min-width:675px}
.uq-cal-month-head,.uq-cal-month-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr))}
.uq-cal-month-head{border-bottom:1px solid var(--cal-line);background:#fafcf9}
.uq-cal-month-head div{padding:14px 5px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#74887d}
.uq-cal-month-cell{min-height:122px;padding:9px 7px 7px;border-right:1px solid var(--cal-line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--cal-line);min-width:0;background:#fff}
.uq-cal-month-cell:nth-child(7n){border-right:0}
.uq-cal-month-cell.outside{background:#fafbf9}
.uq-cal-month-cell.current{background:#f5fcf8}
.uq-cal-month-day{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:5px;margin-bottom:7px}
.uq-cal-day-no{border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:4px 8px;background:transparent;color:#54695f;font-weight:850;font-size:12px}
.uq-cal-month-cell.current .uq-cal-day-no{background:#278d79;color:#fff}
.uq-cal-month-cell.outside .uq-cal-day-no{color:#a7b2aa}
.uq-cal-addday{height:24px;width:24px;background:transparent;color:#a1afa5;font-size:18px;border-radius:7px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.uq-cal-addday:hover{color:#16876e;background:#e4f3eb}
.uq-cal-month-cell .uq-cal-event{width:100%;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:10px;min-height:23px;padding:5px 6px}
.uq-cal-month-cell .uq-cal-event-time{display:inline;font-size:9px;margin:0 4px 0 0}
.uq-cal-month-cell .uq-cal-event-title{display:inline;font-size:10px;vertical-align:baseline}
.uq-cal-more{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;background:transparent;color:#347f6b;padding:3px 4px;text-align:left;width:100%}
.uq-cal-agenda{padding:4px 20px 18px}
.uq-cal-agenda-day{border-bottom:1px solid #edf1ed;padding:17px 0}
.uq-cal-agenda-day:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.uq-cal-agenda-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:11px}
.uq-cal-agenda-heading strong{font-size:14px;font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif}
.uq-cal-agenda-heading small{font-size:11px;color:#88988d}
.uq-cal-agenda-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;border:1px solid #e8eee9;border-left:4px solid #a38ace;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 13px;margin:8px 0;background:#fbf9fe;text-align:left;width:100%;color:#344d43;font-family:inherit}
.uq-cal-agenda-item.done{border-left-color:#2b9f89;background:#f5fcf9}
.uq-cal-agenda-item:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 14px #243b2c0d;background:#eef9f3}
.uq-cal-agenda-time{font-size:12px;font-weight:850;min-width:85px;color:#51685b}
.uq-cal-agenda-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.uq-cal-agenda-main b{display:block;font-size:13px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.uq-cal-agenda-main small{font-size:11px;color:#718477;display:block;margin-top:4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.uq-cal-status{display:inline-flex;font-size:10px;font-weight:850;padding:6px 9px;background:#ede5fa;color:#6f559f;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}
.uq-cal-status.done{background:#e0f5ed;color:#19836f}
.uq-cal-detail-name{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:9px 0 9px;color:#233b31}
.uq-cal-detail-desc{color:#60796b;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;white-space:pre-wrap}
.uq-cal-detail-info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin:17px 0}
.uq-cal-detail-info>div{background:#f6faf6;border-radius:11px;padding:12px;font-size:12px;color:#4b695a;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.uq-cal-detail-info small{display:block;color:#91a097;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:750}
.uq-cal-detail-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--cal-line)}
.uq-cal-no-events{padding:55px 23px;text-align:center;color:#819188;font-size:13px}
.uq-cal-no-events .symbol{font-size:31px;margin-bottom:12px}
.uq-cal-datejump{width:145px;font-size:12px;padding:9px 10px}
.uq-cal-focusbar{padding:13px 20px;background:#f2f9f4;border-bottom:1px solid #e1eee5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;color:#3c785d}
.uq-cal-print{border:1px solid var(--cal-line);background:#fff;color:#557163;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
@media(max-width:950px){.uq-cal-period-name{min-width:170px;font-size:16px}.uq-cal-summary{gap:7px}.uq-cal-stat{padding:11px 13px}.uq-cal-filter{max-width:none}}
@media(max-width:620px){.uq-cal-head-actions{width:100%}.uq-cal-head-actions .btn{width:100%}.uq-cal-topline{padding:13px}.uq-cal-nav{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}.uq-cal-period-name{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:15px;margin-left:3px}.uq-cal-view-switch{width:100%}.uq-cal-view-switch button{flex:1}.uq-cal-filterbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px}.uq-cal-filter{min-width:0}.uq-cal-filter:last-of-type{grid-column:1/-1}.uq-cal-summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.uq-cal-stat{display:block;padding:10px}.uq-cal-stat-icon{height:29px;width:29px;margin-bottom:6px}.uq-cal-stat strong{font-size:20px}.uq-cal-stat small{font-size:10px}.uq-cal-legend{gap:11px}.uq-cal-agenda{padding:3px 12px}.uq-cal-agenda-item{gap:8px;padding:10px}.uq-cal-agenda-time{min-width:53px;font-size:10px}.uq-cal-status{font-size:9px;padding:5px}.uq-cal-detail-info{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uq-cal-datejump{width:120px}}
@media print{.sidebar,.app-top,.mobile-bar,.uq-cal-topline,.uq-cal-filterbar,.uq-cal-head-actions,.uq-cal-addday,.uq-cal-footnote{display:none!important}.app-main{margin:0}.app-content{max-width:none;padding:0}.uq-cal-calendar-box{box-shadow:none;border:0}.uq-cal-scroll{overflow:visible}.uq-cal-week,.uq-cal-month{min-width:0}.uq-cal-week-body{page-break-inside:avoid}}
/* Ajustes para navegação e filtros do cabeçalho no celular. */
@media(max-width:680px){
.app-top{flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:stretch;gap:9px;padding:11px 16px}
.app-top .top-left{width:100%;justify-content:space-between;min-width:0}
.app-top .top-right{width:100%;justify-content:space-between;min-width:0;gap:8px}
.app-top .role-switch{flex:0 0 auto}
.app-top .role-switch button{padding:8px;font-size:10px}
.app-top .student-selector{width:auto;min-width:0;flex:1;padding:8px}
.app-top .profile-trigger{flex:0 0 36px}
}
@media(max-width:620px){
.uq-cal-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto auto auto minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;column-gap:7px;row-gap:11px}
.uq-cal-period-name{font-size:15px;margin-left:0;line-height:1.25}
.uq-cal-datejump{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%}
}
/* V22 · Seleção mensal por nome e ano no Financeiro e no Diário de Aulas. */
.uq-period-panel{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(250px,1.1fr) minmax(235px,1fr);gap:18px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 17px;padding:17px 18px;background:#f6faf7;border:1px solid #e2eee6;border-radius:17px}
.uq-period-month{min-width:0}
.uq-period-month label{font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#315b4c}
.uq-period-controls{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:7px;max-width:420px}
.uq-period-controls select{width:100%;min-width:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d6e6dd;border-radius:12px;font-weight:750;color:#263e36;font-size:13px;min-height:44px;padding:9px 11px}
.uq-period-nav{flex:0 0 39px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid #dce9e0;background:white;color:#397a66;font-size:23px;display:grid;place-items:center;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
.uq-period-nav:hover{background:#e6f5ed;border-color:#b4dcca}
.uq-period-help{font-size:11px;color:#688477;line-height:1.5;margin:7px 0 0}
.uq-period-custom{border:1px solid #e0eae2;background:#fff;border-radius:13px;min-width:0;align-self:center}
.uq-period-custom summary{padding:13px 15px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#537665;list-style-position:inside;user-select:none}
.uq-period-custom[open] summary{border-bottom:1px solid #eaf0eb}
.uq-period-custom-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;padding:13px 14px 15px}
.uq-period-custom-fields .field{min-width:0;margin:0}
.uq-period-custom-fields label{font-size:11px}
.uq-period-custom-fields input{font-size:12px;min-width:0;width:100%;padding:10px 8px}
.uq-period-custom-note{font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;color:#789185;padding:0 14px 12px;margin:0}
.uq-period-area-finance+.finance-filter{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.uq-period-area-finance+.finance-filter .btn{min-height:43px}
.uq-period-area-lessons+.lesson-filters{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));max-width:none}
.uq-period-area-lessons+.lesson-filters.single{display:none}
@media(max-width:940px){.uq-period-panel{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uq-period-area-finance+.finance-filter{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:620px){.uq-period-panel{padding:13px;gap:12px}.uq-period-area-finance+.finance-filter,.uq-period-area-lessons+.lesson-filters{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uq-period-controls{max-width:none}.uq-period-custom-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

const state={viewMode:'student',financeRecords:{},financeLoaded:false,financeLoadError:false,financeFrom:'',financeTo:'',financeMonth:'',financeStudent:'all',financeTeacher:'all',financeStatus:'all',ifesDetail:'',auth:null,db:null,user:null,profile:null,demo:false,section:'home',target:'all',teacherTargetCache:'all',users:[],aulas:[],simulados:[],resultados:[],plano:[],listeners:[],quiz:null,quizAnswers:{},quizIndex:0,review:null,viewFilter:'all',search:'',planFilter:'todas',teacherSimPanel:'lista',calendarView:'week',calendarDate:'',calendarTeacher:'all',calendarStatus:'all',calendarSearch:'',calendarFocusDay:'',loading:false,materiais:[],materialFilter:'todos',materialSearch:'',storage:null,uploading:false,lessonTeacher:'all',lessonStudents:[],financeStudents:[],uqMultiOpen:'',lessonFrom:'',lessonTo:'',lessonMonth:'',taskSearch:'',taskFilter:'all',avatarUrl:'',avatarCacheKey:'',ifesAccess:{},ifesAccessLoaded:false,ifesProgress:{},ifesSubject:'portugues',ifesOpenUnits:{'portugues-01':true},ifesManage:false,ifesStudentSearch:'',ifesQuery:'',ifesPendingOnly:false,ifesProgressUid:'',ifesProgressUnsub:null};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const esc=x=>String(x??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const escapeAttr=esc;
const objList=o=>o&&typeof o==='object'?Object.entries(o).filter(([k,v])=>v&&typeof v==='object').map(([id,v])=>({id,...v})):[];
const today=()=>{const d=new Date();return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`};
const dateBR=s=>{if(!s)return 'Sem data';const d=/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(s));return d?`${d[3]}/${d[2]}/${d[1]}`:String(s)};
const dateShort=s=>{let a=dateBR(s).split('/');return a.length===3?{day:a[0],month:['jan','fev','mar','abr','mai','jun','jul','ago','set','out','nov','dez'][Number(a[1])-1]||a[1]}:{day:'--',month:'--'}};
const num=n=>Math.max(0,Number(n)||0);
const dateOnly=t=>{const d=new Date(t);return isNaN(d)?today():`${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`};
const dur=(a,b)=>{if(!a||!b)return 0;let [h,m]=a.split(':').map(Number),[j,n]=b.split(':').map(Number);let x=(j*60+n)-(h*60+m);return x<0?x+1440:x};
const fmtDur=m=>{m=Math.round(num(m));return m>=60?`${Math.floor(m/60)}h${m%60?` ${m%60}min`:''}`:`${m}min`};
const accountTeacher=()=>state.demo||state.profile?.role==='teacher'||state.user?.email?.toLowerCase()===OWNER_EMAIL;
const teacher=()=>accountTeacher()&&state.viewMode==='teacher';
const owner=()=>state.demo?state.viewMode==='teacher':state.user?.email?.toLowerCase()===OWNER_EMAIL;
const previewReadOnly=()=>false; // Professor em modo aluno usa sua própria conta normalmente

const parent=()=>state.profile?.role==='parent';
const uid=()=>state.user?.uid||'';

const linked=id=>{if(owner())return true;const u=state.users.find(x=>x.id===id);return !!u&&(u.id===uid()||u.createdBy===uid()||u.professorUid===uid()||u.teacherUid===uid()||u.ownerTeacherUid===uid()||u.linkedTeacherUid===uid()||u.linkedTeachers?.[uid()]===true||u.teacherIds?.[uid()]===true)};

const chosen=()=>state.target==='all'?null:state.target;
const filtered=arr=>(arr||[]).filter(x=>{if(!teacher()||parent())return x.studentUid===(parent()?state.profile?.studentUid:studentContextUid());return (state.target==='all'||x.studentUid===state.target)&&visible(x)});
const simulations=()=>state.simulados.filter(s=>teacher()?(owner()||mine(s)):(s.status==='publicado'&&audience(s,studentContextUid())));
const canViewResult=r=>teacher()||state.simulados.find(s=>s.id===r.simuladoId)?.showResult!==false;
const simQuestions=s=>objList(s?.questoes).sort((a,b)=>num(a.ordem)-num(b.ordem));
function errorText(e){let c=String(e?.code||e?.message||e||'').toLowerCase();return c.includes('permission')?'Sem permissão no Firebase. Verifique as regras da conta.':c.includes('invalid')||c.includes('wrong-password')||c.includes('user-not-found')?'Login ou senha incorretos.':c.includes('network')?'Erro de conexão. let toastTimeout=null;function toast(message,bad=false){const e=$('toast');e.textContent=message;e.classList.toggle('bad',bad);e.style.display='block';clearTimeout(toastTimeout);toastTimeout=setTimeout(()=>e.style.display='none',4200)}
function section(id){if(id==='calendario'&&!teacher())return toast('Calendário disponível somente no modo Professor.',true);if(id==='pessoas'&&!teacher())return toast('Acesso restrito ao modo Professor.',true);if(id==='enem'&&!canSeeEnem())return toast('ENEM não liberado para esta conta.',true);if(state.section==='enem'&&id!=='enem'){state.enemDetail='';disconnectEnemProgress()}if(id==='financeiro'&&!financeViewer())return toast('Financeiro exclusivo da conta administradora.',true);if(state.section==='ifes'&&id!=='ifes')state.ifesDetail='';if(id==='ifes'&&!canSeeIfes())return toast('Acesso ao IFES não liberado para esta conta.',true);state.section=id;state.quiz=null;state.review=null;state.search='';state.viewFilter='all';if(id==='ifes')connectIfesProgress();if(id==='enem')connectEnemProgress();renderNav();render();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})}
function renderNav(){const allowed=navs.filter(([id])=>(id!=='ifes'||canSeeIfes())&&(id!=='enem'||canSeeEnem())&&(id!=='financeiro'||financeViewer())&&(id!=='pessoas'||teacher())&&(id!=='calendario'||teacher()));const html=allowed.map(([id,label])=>`<button class="nav-link ${state.section===id?'active':''}" data-action="nav" data-id="${id}" aria-current="${state.section===id?'page':'false'}"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${icons[id]}</svg><span>${label}</span></button>`).join('');$('desktop-nav').innerHTML=html;$('mobile-nav').innerHTML=html;$('crumb').textContent=allowed.find(x=>x[0]===state.section)?.[1]||'Visão geral';}
function renderRoleControl(){
const el=$('role-mode-control'),notice=$('preview-notice');if(!el)return;
if(accountTeacher()){
el.classList.remove('hidden');
el.innerHTML=`<button type="button" data-action="switch-role" data-id="teacher" class="${teacher()?'active':''}" title="Administrar alunos, aulas e financeiro">✎ Professor</button><button type="button" data-action="switch-role" data-id="student" class="${!teacher()?'active':''}" title="Usar minha própria conta como aluno">☘ Aluno</button>`;
}else{el.classList.remove('hidden');el.innerHTML='<span class="role-label">☘ Modo aluno</span>'}
if(notice){
const show=accountTeacher()&&!teacher();
notice.classList.toggle('hidden',!show);
if(show)notice.textContent='Você está no modo Aluno da sua própria conta. Pode fazer simulados e concluir suas tarefas normalmente. Para gerenciar seus alunos, volte ao modo Professor.';
}
}
function switchRole(role){
if(!accountTeacher())return toast('O modo professor depende de uma conta autorizada.',true);
if(role!=='teacher'&&role!=='student')return;
if(role===state.viewMode)return;
if(role==='student'){
state.teacherTargetCache=state.target;
state.target=uid(); // apenas dados próprios: não representar outro aluno
}else{
state.target=state.teacherTargetCache||'all';
}
state.viewMode=role;
state.quiz=null;state.review=null;state.ifesDetail='';state.section='home';state.search='';state.financeStatus='all';
connectIfesProgress();shell();
toast(role==='student'?'Modo Aluno ativado para sua própria conta.':'Modo Professor ativado.');
}
function shell(){const name=state.profile?.name||state.user?.email?.split('@')[0]||'Visitante';$('mini-name').textContent=name;$('mini-role').textContent=teacher()?'Professor':parent()?'Família':'Estudante';renderRoleControl();$('mini-avatar').textContent=name.slice(0,1).toUpperCase();$('demo-label').classList.toggle('hidden',!state.demo);$('student-picker').classList.toggle('hidden',!teacher());renderStudentPicker();renderNav();refreshAvatar();$('landing').style.display='none';$('auth-screen').classList.add('hidden');$('app').style.display='block';render()}
function renderStudentPicker(){let el=$('student-picker');if(!teacher())return;let options=state.users.filter(x=>x.role==='student'&&!x.mergedInto&&!x.hiddenMerged).sort((a,b)=>(a.name||'').localeCompare(b.name||'','pt-BR'));if(state.target!=='all'&&!options.some(x=>x.id===state.target))state.target='all';el.innerHTML=`<option value="all">Todos os alunos</option>`+options.map(x=>`<option value="${escapeAttr(x.id)}">${esc(x.name||x.email||'Aluno')}</option>`).join('');el.value=state.target}
function closeModal(){$('modal-cover').classList.remove('open');$('modal').classList.remove('drive-preview-modal');$('modal').innerHTML=''}
function modal(html){$('modal').classList.remove('drive-preview-modal');$('modal').innerHTML=`<button class="modal-close" data-action="close-modal" aria-label="Fechar">×</button>${html}`;$('modal-cover').classList.add('open');const first=$('modal').querySelector('input:not([type=hidden]),select,textarea');if(first)setTimeout(()=>first.focus(),20)}
function safeWrite(callback){if(previewReadOnly()){toast('Prévia de aluno: alterações desativadas.',true);return Promise.resolve(false)}if(state.demo){toast('Demonstração: explore à vontade. Para salvar de verdade, entre na sua conta.');return Promise.resolve(false)}return callback()}
const empty=(emoji,title,detail='')=>`<div class="empty"><div class="emoji">${emoji}</div><strong>${esc(title)}</strong>${detail?`<div style="margin-top:6px">${esc(detail)}</div>`:''}</div>`;
const xpOf=({aulas,plano,resultados})=>Math.round(aulas.filter(a=>(a.statusFinanceiro||'')!=='previsto').length*20 + plano.filter(i=>i.feito).reduce((n,i)=>n+Math.min(500,Math.max(10,num(i.xp)||50)),0)+resultados.length*100);
function gathered(){let a=filtered(state.aulas),p=filtered(state.plano),r=filtered(state.resultados);let xp=xpOf({aulas:a,plano:p,resultados:r});let level=Math.floor(xp/400)+1;let current=xp%400;return {aulas:a,plano:p,resultados:r,xp,level,current,percent:Math.round(current/400*100),simul:simulations().filter(s=>teacher()?(state.target==='all'||s.studentUid==='all'||s.studentUid===state.target):true)};}
function levelTitle(level){return ['Novato','Explorador','Desbravador','Estrategista','Mestre da Jornada'][Math.min(Math.floor((level-1)/2),4)]}
function completionBadge(n){return n>=80?'🏆 Excelente!':n>=60?'✦ Boa evolução':'✳ Continue treinando'}
function weeklyBars(data){const days=['Dom','Seg','Ter','Qua','Qui','Sex','Sáb'];const dates=[];for(let i=6;i>=0;i--){const d=new Date();d.setDate(d.getDate()-i);let key=dateOnly(d);let count=data.plano.filter(x=>x.feito&&(x.concluidoEm||x.completedAt)&&dateOnly(x.concluidoEm||x.completedAt)===key).length+data.resultados.filter(x=>x.enviadoEm&&dateOnly(x.enviadoEm)===key).length;dates.push({day:days[d.getDay()],count})}let max=Math.max(1,...dates.map(x=>x.count));return `<div class="bar-list">${dates.map(x=>`<div class="bar-col"><div class="bar-bg"><div class="bar-active" style="height:${Math.max(x.count?13:0,Math.round(x.count/max*100))}%"></div></div>${x.day}</div>`).join('')}</div>`}
function home(){let d=gathered();const finished=d.plano.filter(x=>x.feito).length,total=d.plano.length,ratio=total?Math.round(finished/total*100):0, pending=d.plano.filter(x=>!x.feito).sort((a,b)=>(a.prazo||'9999').localeCompare(b.prazo||'9999')).slice(0,3),scores=d.resultados.filter(canViewResult).map(x=>num(x.resultado?.aproveitamento)).filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x));const average=scores.length?Math.round(scores.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/scores.length):null;const greetings=['Seu próximo nível começa aqui.','Uma pequena vitória por vez.','Seu esforço constrói a jornada.'];let greet=greetings[new Date().getDate()%greetings.length];const name=!teacher()?(state.profile?.name||'Estudante'):(state.target==='all'?'Professor':(userName(state.target)||state.profile?.name||'Estudante'));return `<div class="section-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">VISÃO GERAL · SUA JORNADA</div><h2>Olá, ${esc(name.split(' ')[0])} <span style="font-size:.75em">✳</span></h2><p>${greet}</p></div><span class="pill"><span class="dot"></span> ${new Intl.DateTimeFormat('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'long'}).format(new Date())}</span></div>
<div class="journey-hero"><div><span class="eyebrow">NÃO É SÓ ESTUDAR.
